page.overview:
Who is The Evil Masters?

The Evil Masters were a fighting clan that would have likely aided the Deadly Alliance as they were planned but later removed from the final product of Mortal Kombat: Deadly Alliance.

By fare, these characters have never made an official appearance in the Mortal Kombat universe, being only featured in the Krypt as concept art.
